status.description: Order status filter: Any, Open, Shipped, Delivered or Cancelled. Use Any when the customer doesn't say.

from.description: Optional earliest order date as an ISO 8601 date, for example 2026-10-01. Leave it empty for no lower limit.

to.description: Optional latest order date as an ISO 8601 date, for example 2026-11-13. Leave it empty for no upper limit.
